title: Survey of Youths in Custody, 1987:  [United States]
description:
This data collection, the first survey of youths confined to 
 long-term, state-operated institutions, was undertaken to complement 
 existing Children in Custody censuses. It also serves as a companion to 
 the Surveys of State Prisons, allowing comparisons between adult and 
 juvenile populations. The survey provides detailed information on the 
 characteristics of youths held primarily in secure settings within the 
 juvenile justice system. The data contain information on criminal 
 histories, family situations, drug and alcohol use, and peer group 
 activities. For youths committed for violent acts, data are available 
on the victims of their crimes and on weapon use.
